title: Run final handoff compatibility and verification gate
description: After all implementation, tests, docs, and skills land, inspect the combined diff for contract drift and overlapping edits. Verify old stores without handoffs.json, existing task JSON, legacy CLI flags, no-handoff task output, shared storage, and canonical export behavior remain compatible. Apply only small integration fixes needed for the agreed contract, run gofmt validation, go test ./..., go vet ./..., both skill quick validators, and ./scripts/verify.sh commit. Record concrete failures and pause rather than weakening tests or changing scope.
